description: UCI row 3 (age 45, MEDIUM vulnerability, basic knowledge, RT 4, horizon 5yr) — ig corporate bond etf: all hard rules pass (score 100) -> SUITABLE
client_narrative: Annika Bergström is 45 years old and works as a project coordinator at a public sector organisation. Her annual income is approximately 47,300 euros and she holds 18,000 euros in liquid savings. She wants to invest 10,000 euros over a 5-year horizon to grow her long-term savings. Her investment knowledge is basic: she has previously purchased equity mutual funds and bond funds through her bank but has not traded individual securities or derivatives. She rates her risk tolerance at 4 out of 10 and has confirmed she can afford to lose the full invested amount. Her main objective is capital preservation.
product_narrative: The product is a passively managed exchange-traded fund that tracks a broad investment-grade corporate bond index covering eurozone and European issuers rated BBB- or above. The fund is non-complex, listed on regulated markets, publishes a KID, and uses no leverage or derivatives. It requires only basic financial knowledge and has a minimum recommended holding period of three years. In adverse credit market conditions the fund may deliver partial capital loss.
